elements.description:
A year of activity, a square per day in a column per week, shaded by how much happened – with month and weekday
names, a total, and the day's value on hover or focus.

properties.name: heading
properties.description: The heading, and the grid's name

properties.name: days
properties.description: The days with activity, in any order; a day not listed counts as 0

properties.name: end
properties.description: The last day shown, as epoch ms of any moment in it; by default the latest day in `days`

properties.name: weeks
properties.description: How many weeks to show, ending with the week of `end`

properties.name: weekStart
properties.description: The first day of the week, as the first row: 0 Sunday, 1 Monday … 6 Saturday

properties.name: max
properties.description: The value that shades a day fully; by default the busiest day shown

properties.name: levels
properties.description: How many shades, counting empty: 5 is empty and four steps of activity

properties.name: unit
properties.description: What the values count, after the number: "12 events"

properties.name: format
properties.description: Writes a value in full, e.g. (v) => `${v} reviews`; replaces the number and `unit`

properties.name: selected
properties.description: The selected day, as epoch ms of its local midnight. Changed by the user unless a tc-selected-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: locale
properties.description: The language for month, weekday and number names, e.g. "en-GB"; by default the browser's

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-selected-change
events.description: A day was selected or cleared ({ selected, value }: ActivityCalendarSelectedChange); cancelable – prevented, `selected` stays as it was

props.name: title
props.description: The heading, and the grid's name

props.name: selected
props.description: The selected day as epoch ms of its local midnight – controlled when given (null for none)

props.name: defaultSelected
props.description: The day selected on mount when `selected` isn't controlled

props.name: onSelectedChange
props.type: (selected: number | null, value?: number | null) => void
props.description: A day was selected or cleared; `value` is its value (null when it has no data)

changelog: **`tc-activity-calendar`:** a year of activity, contribution-graph style. - **Layout:** a column per week and a row per weekday, ending on `end`, with `weeks` and `week-start` settings. - **Labels:** month names along the top, and weekday names pinned down the side while the weeks scroll. The newest week starts in view. - **Values:** a missing day counts as 0, and null is outlined as no data. - **Header, footer and selection:** the total in the header; the footer reads out the day under the pointer or focus. A selected day is reported with a cancelable `tc-selected-change`. - **Keyboard:** ↑ ↓ move a day, ← → a week, Page keys four weeks.

features.name: light-dark()
features.why: Every colour token is a light / dark pair; without it no colour token resolves.

features.name: color-mix()
features.why: Tints and washes mixed from the tokens.

features.name: Container size queries
features.why: Components adapt to the width they're given, not the window's.

features.name: :is() and :where()
features.why: Every rule is keyed on :where() so the page can override it.

features.name: scrollbar-width
features.without: Scrollbars keep the browser's default width.

features.name: adoptedStyleSheets
features.without: Each element type's CSS goes into one <style> element in <head> instead – it looks and works the same.

features.name: forced-colors media query
features.without: In a forced-colours mode the browser's own adjustments apply, without the components' fixes.
